configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Ninja + the compiler on PATH (MSVC cl after tools/devshell.ps1). One build dir per preset.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: No optimization, full debug info. For stepping through code, NOT for listening: DSP can run 10-50x slower.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Fully optimized (/O2 /Ob2). Not RelWithDebInfo: with MSVC that uses /Ob1, which limits inlining and slows DSP code.

workflowPresets.name: release
workflowPresets.description: Configure, build and test Release in one command: cmake --workflow --preset release
